Name: Oracle Fusion ERP Separation of Duties (SoD) Matrix
Description: Comprehensive 27-control Separation of Duties (SoD) matrix detecting toxic and conflicting role combinations across Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Fixed Assets, Inventory, Payroll/HCM, and Security Administration in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP. This is a platform-defined control set aligned with the named real regulatory framework's known objectives, not a verbatim transcription of an official published checklist — organizations achieve SOX 404 / SOC 1 / SoD compliance through their own internal controls program, not a single external document.

Requirements.Name: AP Invoice Creation vs Payment Disbursement Segregation
Requirements.Description: Prevents a single user from creating/modifying vendor invoices and executing electronic payment disbursements or printing checks (Fraud Risk: Unauthorized vendor payments).

Requirements.Name: Purchase Order Generation vs AP Invoice Matching Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures purchasing agents cannot approve invoices against the purchase orders they generated (Fraud Risk: Fictitious PO-to-Invoice matching).

Requirements.Name: Vendor Master Maintenance vs Payment Processing Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures users with authority to create or update vendor bank details cannot disburse payments to those vendors (Fraud Risk: Fictitious vendor creation & bank routing fraud).

Requirements.Name: Purchase Requisition Creation vs Purchase Order Approval
Requirements.Description: Ensures employees requesting goods/services cannot independently approve and execute the corresponding purchase orders without managerial authorization.

Requirements.Name: Goods Receipt Entry vs AP Invoice Processing
Requirements.Description: Ensures warehouse receiving personnel entering goods receipts cannot also process or match accounts payable supplier invoices.

Requirements.Name: Supplier Bank Account Modification vs Payment Approval
Requirements.Description: Prevents users modifying supplier remittance bank accounts from approving electronic funds transfer (EFT) payment batches.

Requirements.Name: Manual Journal Entry vs Journal Approval & Posting Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures accountants creating manual journal entries cannot approve or post their own journals to the General Ledger without independent peer review.

Requirements.Name: Chart of Accounts Maintenance vs General Ledger Posting
Requirements.Description: Ensures users maintaining account structures, segment values, and accounting rules cannot also post transactional journals to those accounts.

Requirements.Name: Accounting Period Close vs Journal Entry Creation
Requirements.Description: Ensures users with privileges to open and close accounting periods cannot enter post-dated or back-dated financial journals.

Requirements.Name: Intercompany Transaction Initiation vs Intercompany Approval
Requirements.Description: Ensures intercompany balancing entries cannot be initiated and approved by the same accountant across operating units.

Requirements.Name: Financial Statement Generation vs General Ledger Configuration
Requirements.Description: Ensures financial report designers cannot modify posting rules or general ledger journal source definitions.

Requirements.Name: Billing / Invoicing vs Cash Application & Reconciliation
Requirements.Description: Ensures billing specialists generating customer invoices cannot apply cash receipts or process unallocated payments (Fraud Risk: Lapping and fictitious revenue).

Requirements.Name: Customer Master File Maintenance vs Credit Limit Approval
Requirements.Description: Ensures sales personnel creating customer accounts cannot unilaterally override or approve credit limits without risk management sign-off.

Requirements.Name: Credit Memo Creation vs AR Balance Write-Off Segregation
Requirements.Description: Ensures employees issuing customer credit memos cannot write off customer receivable balances without dual authorization.

Requirements.Name: Sales Order Entry vs Order Release / Shipment Confirmation
Requirements.Description: Ensures sales order entry staff cannot confirm inventory release or dispatch shipments without warehouse fulfillment sign-off.

Requirements.Name: Customer Bank Account Setup vs Direct Debit Receipt Processing
Requirements.Description: Prevents staff entering customer bank direct-debit mandates from executing automatic fund collection batches.

Requirements.Name: Asset Capitalization / Creation vs Asset Depreciation / Retirement
Requirements.Description: Ensures users adding new capital assets cannot process asset retirement, write-downs, or disposal transactions.

Requirements.Name: Physical Inventory Count Entry vs Inventory Adjustment Approval
Requirements.Description: Ensures staff recording physical inventory stock counts cannot approve inventory cost adjustments or stock write-offs.

Requirements.Name: Standard Cost Definition vs Cost Adjustment Posting
Requirements.Description: Ensures cost accountants defining standard item costs cannot post inventory revaluation journals.

Requirements.Name: Employee Master Setup vs Payroll Calculation & Disbursement
Requirements.Description: Ensures HR personnel entering new employee records or modifying compensation cannot execute payroll disbursements (Fraud Risk: Ghost employees).

Requirements.Name: Time & Labor Entry Approval vs Payroll Execution
Requirements.Description: Ensures managers approving contractor or employee timesheets cannot execute payroll batch processing.

Requirements.Name: Employee Bank Account Setup vs Payroll Electronic Payment
Requirements.Description: Ensures HR administrators maintaining employee direct deposit banking details cannot execute automated payroll payment files.

Requirements.Name: Application Implementation Consultant vs Security Management
Requirements.Description: Ensures implementation consultant super-privileges (Application Implementation Consultant) are not combined with ongoing IT Security Manager duties post-go-live.

Requirements.Name: Security Console User Admin vs Business Transaction Execution
Requirements.Description: Ensures IT administrators with user provisioning and role assignment privileges do not hold functional transaction roles in production.

Requirements.Name: Audit Configuration Management vs User Privilege Assignment
Requirements.Description: Ensures users configuring audit policies cannot assign or modify user accounts, preventing audit trail suppression.

Requirements.Name: Database Administrator / Integration Lead vs Functional Accounting
Requirements.Description: Ensures technical integration developers and database administrators cannot hold business transaction posting privileges.
